title: Count the calls
prompt: Implement `int g(int n)`: the total number of calls f(n) makes (including itself), where f halves n each time. A loop counting halvings is fine — the point is the mental model: calls = frames on the stack at the deepest point.

tests.name: frames counted
tests.hint: int calls = 0; while (n > 1) { calls++; n /= 2; } return calls + 1;
